{{ModeTabs}} {{ModeInfobox |title1 = {{Color|VoidcoreMode}} |image1 = VoidcoreIcon.png |waves = 50 |level_requirement = {{Level|50}} |starting_cash = Solo: *{{Money|900}} *{{Money|1,000}} (Group Bonus) Duo: *{{Money|750}} *{{Money|850}} (Group Bonus) Trio: *{{Money|600}} *{{Money|700}} (Group Bonus) |rewards = {{Gem|700}}, {{Coins|1,000}}, {{Exp|500}} & {{TowerExp|420}} |time = 55:00 }} ==Description== '''Voidcore''' mode is one of the two hardcore modes, being the most difficult mode in the entire game. It can only be played by using the center [[Elevators|Hardcore Elevator]] or through the hardcore [[Matchmaking]] menu. Like [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, '''Voidcore''' mode rewards {{Gem|Gems}} instead of {{Coins|Coins}}, but unlike Hardcore mode {{Coins|Coins}} can be earned upon successful completion of this mode. You need to first triumph [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and be at least {{Level|50}} to play this mode. Cash is only gained if an enemy is killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. It uses a slightly different method of distributing cash between players, as enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player does all the damage to an enemy, both players will receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you receive 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it is damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo and 33% If it is a decimal, it gets rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it is at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it is less than 0.5, it gets rounded down. Consumables and [[Skills]] are disabled in this mode. [[Shrines]] also appears in this mode starting from Wave 11, re-appearing every 10 waves. ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 100% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 2x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. These {{Exp|}} bonuses multiply {{Exp|}} after it has been multiplied by modifiers. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Currently, rewards are calculated as: {| class="tds-table" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Gems Reward !Coins Reward !EXP Reward !Tower EXP Reward |- |{{Gem|250}} ÷ (1 + [(50 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^3) + {{Gem|450}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{Coins|1,000}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{Exp|200}} ÷ (1 + [(50 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{Exp|300}} (Triumph Bonus) |{{TowerExp|190}} ÷ (1 + [(50 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]) + {{TowerExp|230}} (Triumph Bonus) |} Triumphing '''Voidcore''' mode can give out an additional reward, which can be a crate, consumable or ticket. They are meant to be guaranteed, though due to a bug this does not always happen. Additionally, items are sometimes not given out. These items are: TBA ===Badges=== There are also six [[badges]] which you can obtain when playing this mode, which may have additional rewards alongside the [[Badges|badge]].
